papers.title: Cocktail-Talker: Multi-Speaker Dialog Modeling in Noisy Social Environments with Turn Action GRPO
papers.authors: Xilin Jiang, Riki Shimizu, Sukru Samet Dindar, Junkai Wu, Zhongweiyang Xu, Nima Mesgarani
papers.abstract: Introduces Cocktail-Talker, a speech LLM framework for multi-speaker dialog in noisy social environments. Uses three action tokens (respond/listen/ignore) to decide whether to speak. Trained via supervised finetuning and GRPO reinforcement learning. Includes Cocktail-DialogGen, an LLM-based data pipeline for realistic multi-speaker dialogs.

papers.title: WeSep: A Modular and Cue-Composable Framework for Target Speaker Extraction
papers.authors: Ke Zhang, Xiaoyang Yu, Haoyu Li, Shuai Wang, Shuhan Zhang, Haizhou Li
papers.abstract: Presents WeSep, a unified TSE framework with decoupled cue modules and separator backbones via standardized interfaces. Supports enrollment, spatial, visual, and textual cues. Accepted by Interspeech 2026. Toolkit to be publicly available.

papers.title: VocalRender: Score-Native Singing Voice Synthesis for Real-World Composition
papers.abstract: Score-native singing voice synthesis system using interleaved lyric-note representation and autoregressive diffusion model. Trained on 2,300-hour singing dataset. Eliminates explicit duration prediction, outperforming baselines by 0.42 points in naturalness CMOS.

papers.title: Teffic-Audio: Tell Fact from Fiction — General Speech Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract: General speech deepfake detection system using Conformer-based encoder + attentive statistics pooling. Achieves pooled EER of 1.454% on 14 test sets of Speech-DF-Arena, outperforming all public systems. Trained only with open-source data.

papers.title: Enhancing Law-Enforcement Audio Transcription: A LoRA-Based Adaptation of Whisper for BWC Footage
papers.abstract: Adapts OpenAI Whisper for body-worn camera footage transcription using LoRA PEFT. Addresses high-stress police scenarios with sirens/radio interference. Demonstrated on consumer-grade hardware (4GB GPU) with 8-bit quantization and gradient checkpointing, achieving 93.7% lexicon mapping rate.

papers.title: Does EEG Foundation Models Transfer to Speech? A Benchmark on Overt and Imagined Speech Decoding
papers.abstract: First systematic benchmark of EEG foundation models (LaBraM, EEGMamba) vs CNN baselines for speech decoding. Finds that large-scale EEG pretraining yields no consistent advantage over 16K-parameter CNN on speech tasks. Submitted to IberSPEECH 2026.

papers.title: Improved Robustness in AI-Generated Music Detection
papers.abstract: Frequency-scaling-invariant detection pipeline for AI-generated music using log-STFT remapping and learned cross-correlation filter. Addresses robustness to speed/pitch manipulation attacks. Accepted at ISMIR 2026.

papers.title: CrowdioSet and PaRIRset: Two Datasets Towards Live Music Source Separation
papers.abstract: Two novel datasets for live music source separation: CrowdioSet (4800 ambience tracks + synthetic sing-alongs) and PaRIRset (stereo impulse responses from 40 concert venues). Code, weights, and datasets freely available. Accepted at ISMIR 2026.

papers.title: RIPPLE: Generating Multi-Channel Phase, Not Recovering It
papers.abstract: Argues that phase should be generated rather than recovered for multi-channel audio. Reinterprets Griffin-Lim as a phase prior and uses rectified flow for refinement. Demonstrates on ambisonics and seismic cross-station translation, significantly reducing polarization error.

papers.title: Integrating Contextual Embeddings into Evaluation of Expressive MIDI Piano Performances
papers.abstract: Reexamines attribute-scoped metrics for MIDI piano evaluation using contextual embeddings from self-supervised symbolic music models (Aria, CLaMP3). Adapts Kernel Audio Distance to symbolic domain. Releases Pereval open-source evaluation library. Accepted at ISMIR 2026.

news.title: 全双工多模态交互模型：Interaction Models 与 Thinker–Talker 架构解析（iWiki技术分析）
news.summary: Thinking Machines Lab 发布的 Interaction Models 论文提出可扩展的人机交互方法，包含 Thinker–Talker 架构。该文档对全双工语音交互模型进行了技术深度解析。发布于8月2日。

news.title: GPT-Live 全面实测对比：语音AI交互范式革命持续发酵
news.summary: OpenAI 7月8日发布 GPT-Live 后持续引发行业震动，一周内 ChatGPT Voice 用户突破1.5亿。本文深度对比 GPT-Live 与豆包等国产语音AI产品。
